newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt airport in Deutsche Telekom pact.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt airport in Deutsche Telekom pact.

text.p: Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said it signed a cooperation agreement with Deutsche Telekom AG.
Under the agreement, FAG, the owner and manager of Frankfurt airport, and Deutsche Telekom will cooperate in the development and operation of communications networks at the airport, a statement said.
The Telekom D-1 network would be linked to the airport telecommunications system this summer, it added.
Telekom would use networks installed by FAG in projects such as Cargo City South, the future ICE railway station and for the expansion of Terminal One to save duplication of work.
The two companies were also considering setting up an inexpensive, closed mobile communications network for FAG and clients at the airport, the statement said.
FAG board member Johannes Endler added the airport operator was also seeking agreements with other telecommunications companies.
